review_evidence: README states that the project formalizes results from The Matrix Cookbook in Lean/mathlib.
MatrixCookbook modules contain named matrix identities and proved trace/determinant results, alongside stated targets still represented as theorem declarations.
The source therefore provides direct prior art for matrix identities and linear-algebra formulas.
summary: Reviewed lean-matrix-cookbook; retain its matrix identities, theorem statements, and completed linear-algebra proofs.
